tasks.instruction:

This branch and the text branch must be dispatched concurrently, with actual execution overlap recorded by runtime timestamps; independent graph nodes alone are not proof. Implement numbers.mjs exporting sumIntegers(input): sum comma-separated signed safe integers, trim token whitespace, reject empty input and empty tokens, fractions, nonnumbers, unsafe integers, and unsafe sums. Follow all additional original contract requirements. Use only Node/npm built-ins; do not install dependencies, use Python, access credentials, merge, deploy, or modify the source project outside your assigned workspace. Do not implement the sibling module.
Run the applicable npm tests in this workspace and retain actual command, output, exit status, and execution timestamps in evidence/numbers-verification.json. All numbers contracts must pass without TODO/skips; only the intentional missing-sibling contract TODO is acceptable before handoff. Record original contract-file hashes using Node built-ins so integration can verify preservation. Deliver only numbers.mjs and evidence/numbers-verification.json as branch artifacts. Handoff requires the machine check and actual test evidence, not a worker assertion.
